countingNotes: Counts are framework-reported test executions, not individual assertions, line coverage or proof of complete user workflows.
25 shared production-renderer cases are intentionally registered in Node and Vitest; do not sum suite counts as unique coverage.
mcp-example is a validated synthetic output demonstration and is kept separate from unit-test coverage.
Typecheck is a static gate, not an additional passing test.
Rust and performance evidence from other invocations is not included in these independent runner counts.
Additional independent review executions are reported separately, including explicit mutation witnesses. They are not a unique-behavior coverage total.
The AI-generation replay is one additional demonstration gate with 13 internal regression checks; those 13 checks are not 13 additional framework tests.
limitations: Passing only applies to the selected named suites; test files are not assertions or line coverage.
No browser, Electron GUI, GPU driver/readback, installed-app packaging, accessibility or native OS dialog was launched. Real socket tests are separate opt-in and never automatically selected.
No Windows/macOS run is inferred from Linux; consult each actual CI artifact.
Private external corpora may be explicitly skipped unless DESIGN_REQUIRE_PRIVATE_FIXTURES=1.
WASM scalar/SIMD experiments, performance benchmarks and browser check scripts remain separate explicitly requested gates.
OS socket integration was already blocked by permission (listen EPERM; escalation bwrap blocked); no bypass or retry was attempted.
